findings.statement: Open Targets ccRCC association [gene=CA9; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.3088]. Tractable modalities AB, PR, SM (AB: Advanced Clinical). Drugs as returned: GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_3), SULTHIAME (PHASE_4), ETHOXZOLAMIDE (WITHDRAWAL). UniProt Q16790 places it at the cell membrane and microvillus membrane, so it is antibody and imaging accessible. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency [gene=CA9; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.051], and it is not common essential, so this is an antibody/imaging/biomarker case rather than a functional-dependency target. It is not a recurrent driver [gene=CA9; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; mutated_patients=1].

Open Targets ccRCC association is weak [gene=CD70; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.0572]. Tractable modalities AB, OC, PR (AB: Advanced Clinical; OC: Advanced Clinical). Drugs as returned: CUSATUZUMAB (PHASE_2), VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN (PHASE_1). UniProt P32970 places it at the plasma membrane as the ligand of CD27, so it is antibody accessible. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency [gene=CD70; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.251], so the case rests on surface-antigen targeting (ADC, CAR-T, antibody), not on loss of function. No coding mutations were found in either cohort.

Open Targets ccRCC association is light [gene=ENPP3; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.0356]. Tractable modalities AB, OC, PR, SM (OC: Advanced Clinical). Drug as returned: AGS-16C3F (PHASE_2), an antibody-drug conjugate. UniProt O14638 places it at the apical cell membrane, also secreted. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency [gene=ENPP3; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.091], so only a surface-antigen strategy is supported. It is not a recurrent driver.

Established ccRCC drug target (HIF alpha subunit). Open Targets ccRCC association [gene=EPAS1; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.4871]. Drug as returned: BELZUTIFAN (APPROVAL). Tractable modalities PR, SM. Pathways include Regulation of gene expression by Hypoxia-inducible Factor. DepMap is the only selective ccRCC dependency among these candidates [gene=EPAS1; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=-0.143] with selectivity [gene=EPAS1; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; selectivity=0.3]; it is not common essential. It is not recurrently mutated [gene=EPAS1; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; mutated_patients=2], so activation arises through VHL loss rather than EPAS1 mutation.

Top Open Targets ccRCC association [gene=VHL; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.6466]. Driver status confirmed: recurrent, mutated in [gene=VHL; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; mutated_patients=247] of [gene=VHL; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; patients=511] tumours. No drugs for VHL itself because it acts upstream of HIF alpha (EPAS1). DepMap shows the dependency pattern expected of a lost tumour suppressor, with a strongly negative selectivity [gene=VHL; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; selectivity=-0.835], so VHL is a mechanism and stratification marker, not a direct drug target.

Open Targets ccRCC association, supported by a genetic association component [gene=SCARB1; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.4049]. A tractability record exists but no drugs are listed. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency [gene=SCARB1; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.002] and it is not common essential. It is tumour-up in the omics layers, so it is a biomarker or surface-target candidate; the dependency evidence does not support a functional-inhibition case.

Open Targets ccRCC association is weak [gene=NNMT; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.0598]. UniProt P40261 describes a cytoplasmic enzyme (nicotinamide N-methyltransferase) that consumes S-adenosylmethionine and so shapes methylation potential. No drugs returned. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency [gene=NNMT; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.316], so it is a biomarker or mechanism candidate with weak target support.

Open Targets ccRCC association is weak [gene=ALDOB; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.0701]. UniProt P05062 describes cytosolic aldolase B (fructose metabolism) with a tumour-suppressor adapter role through G6PD and TP53. No drugs returned. DepMap shows no ccRCC dependency [gene=ALDOB; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.156]. It is not recurrently mutated [gene=ALDOB; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; mutated_patients=4]. It is a downregulated proximal-tubule marker, so a biomarker and not a drug target.

Established ccRCC drug target (mTOR inhibitors). Open Targets ccRCC association is among the highest [gene=MTOR; type=open_targets_association; source=Open Targets Platform; score=0.525]. Only the association record was queried here, so druggability and dependency were not independently checked in this run.

caveats: Dependency and tractability were queried only for a subset of top-ranked candidates; MTOR and several proximal-tubule biomarkers (SLC22A8, PIGR, FABP1, UMOD) were not checked individually.

The DepMap ccRCC panel has few lines; none of CA9, CD70, ENPP3, SCARB1, NNMT or ALDOB are dependencies, so these cases rest on expression selectivity and antibody/imaging/ADC modalities, not on functional essentiality.

Open Targets association scores are literature/genetics based and are low for most expression-driven candidates (CD70, ENPP3, NNMT, ALDOB), reflecting less prior evidence rather than absence of biology.
Drug stages are reported as returned by Open Targets and do not imply ccRCC-specific trials.
